# coinTrack

> Live broker aggregation + manual alternative-asset ledgers (India).
> Your portfolio, set in clear type.

## What coinTrack does
- Aggregates Zerodha, Upstox, and Angel One portfolios in real-time
- Manual ledgers: Gold & Silver (with live bullion rates), EPF, PPF, Fixed Deposits, Mutual Funds (FIFO capital gains engine)
- Unified net-worth calculation, asset allocation drift, P&L analysis, and tax-ready reports
- Bank-grade authentication: Google OAuth, TOTP 2FA, session lifecycle management

## Public surfaces (included in sitemap)
- / — landing page (product overview, integrations, security)
- /calculators — 32+ financial calculators (SIP, EMI, PPF, EPF, HRA, Income Tax, NPS, etc.)

## Auth & protected endpoints
- /dashboard, /portfolio, /brokers, /mutual-fund, /fixed-deposit, /ppf, /epf, /gold-silver, /notes, /profile

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Radix UI Primitives, TanStack Query
- Security: Edge route protection, HTTP-only cookie support, zero-trust external domain boundary
- Backend: Spring Boot enterprise service with multi-tenant isolation
- Deployment: Vercel (Frontend), Render (Backend)
